🌟 We're Hiring: Solutions Engineer (AI, Automation & Integrations)
q: We are a technology-driven organization focused on developing intelligent business solutions through artificial intelligence, workflow automation, and system integrations. Our work combines emerging technologies with practical engineering approaches to help businesses streamline operations, improve productivity, and build connected digital environments. We value innovation, technical problem-solving, and the ability to transform complex business requirements into effective technology solutions.

We are looking for a Solutions Engineer specializing in AI, Automation & Integrations to support the design and implementation of intelligent technical solutions. In this part-time remote position, you will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to understand operational challenges, develop automation strategies, and connect different systems through reliable integrations. You will play an important role in translating business needs into scalable solutions while contributing to technology innovation and operational efficiency.
Design and coordinate AI-powered solutions based on business and operational requirements.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive workflows and improve operational efficiency.
Develop and oversee integrations between business applications, platforms, and internal systems.
Evaluate AI tools, automation technologies, and integration approaches for practical applications.
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and define technical solution strategies.
Support the implementation, testing, and optimization of automated workflows.
Monitor solution performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Coordinate with developers, IT specialists, and external technology partners.
Prepare technical documentation, solution proposals, and implementation updates.
Ensure solutions follow appropriate standards for reliability, data handling, and security.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 3+ years of relevant professional experience preferred.
Strong understanding of AI applications, workflow automation, and system integration concepts.
Knowledge of APIs, data exchange, and application connectivity.
Familiarity with automation platforms, AI-powered tools, and business process optimization.
Understanding of software development principles and technical solution design.
Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Ability to manage technical projects independently in a remote working environment.
Flexible part-time working hours with a fully remote arrangement.
Competitive compensation based on technical expertise and experience.
Opportunities to work on AI-driven solutions and business automation initiatives.
Exposure to emerging technologies and international integration projects.
Professional growth through practical involvement in innovative technology solutions.
A collaborative environment that encourages experimentation, technical creativity, and continuous improvement.

d: As a Store Manager at Tesla, you are a seasoned and charismatic retail leader, responsible for overseeing and driving sales and delivery operations at your location. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the overall management and sales execution, recruitment, training, and development of a dynamic store team. Your team will look to you to set the standard for open communication, active problem solving, and a positive work environment. We expect you to be 100% committed to the success of your team, and actively involve yourself in your team members’ growth and development. You are a hands-on coach with a strong business acumen. You seek constant improvement of performance and have a strong understanding of numbers and KPIs.
Your job comes with a high level of autonomy that enables you to creatively develop your operation which also entails a large responsibility of self-evaluation and constantly seeking excellence.
